newsitem.title: DENMARK: Goldman see Novo still market outperformer.
newsitem.headline: Goldman see Novo still market outperformer.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs said it reiterated its market outperformer rating for Danish biotechnology group Novo Nordisk A/S in its latest global pharmaceutical valuation sheet received by Reuters on Monday.
"We reiterate our Market Outperformer rating on Novo Nordisk..," Goldman Sachs wrote in a sheet dated December 5.

"We maintain our overweight stance in the U.K., Europe and the U.S. but acknowledge that the excellent share price performances year-to-date (particularly in Europe and the U.K.) are likely to result in further near-term profit-taking.

Goldman estimated EPS (earnings per share) of 47.63 crowns, 54.58 crowns and 62.33 crowns respectively for Novo stock in 1996, 1997 and 1998, against only 41.55 crowns in 1995 with P/E at a share price of 1,070 crowns at 22.5, 19.6 and 17.2 for the same period against 25.7 last year.
The Novo Nordisk share stood at 1,049 crowns at 1305 gmt, one crown down from the opening.
